headline: Fishermans Row Flares Anew as Dead Lands Bleed and Stonecradle Tilts
war_summary: Fishermans Row, still as a millpond at our last writing, has burst into flame again: twenty-five flag events mark the day there, the last logged as this edition closed, with Arcadia, Black Well and Eidolo in the thick of the trade and two of its nine works now no-man's-land. The Dead Lands, quiet in our previous account, bleeds heavily once more — 2,576 Warden and 1,009 Colonial fallen in the day, most within recent hours and the pace still climbing, though all eleven works fly Colonial colours. Godcrofts' furious churn has lapsed: fifty-six flags in the day, the last logged hours before press, its nine works unchanged. Stonecradle has tipped Warden-ward, five works to four, World's End the busiest ground before the front went silent these two hours past. Stlican Shelf still turns about Fort Hoarfrost, an event logged at press time, seven Warden works to two Colonial. Weathered Expanse remains costliest at some 23,000 fallen in the day, its five-to-four Colonial line holding as Frostmarch and Crow's Nest trade; Callahan's Passage follows near 18,500, its hourly toll easing. The ledger reads 294 Colonial works to 140 Warden, two in ruin. Day 254; no victor declared.
